about_the_game: Experience the captivating soundscape of ZEPHON beyond the game with this standalone original soundtrack, featuring music from three distinct branches and ambient from the game's leaders and quests. Immerse yourself in the hard rock militaristic beats of the Human path, the sharp methodical synths of Cyber, or the primal ominous melodies of the Voice—there's a journey for every mood.
